content.description: P1 it01: keep Saval car-following values; lower red-running to the observed moto share, switch early_start on at the observed M2 share, and make 30% of motorcycles space seekers with wrong-lane and sidewalk options sized from the F2 targets.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Unchanged (Saval et al. 2023 Table 11). Cars already match M3/share/car (0.0041, cars stop at red) and no feedback shows a car car-following error, so nothing is moved.
Unchanged: no rule applies to custom2 on the proxy net, so it must behave like car_saval; the share has no effect on M8/car or M3/share/car.

Car-following values unchanged (Saval Table 11; M1/moto discharge headway 0.2957 s). Share lowered 0.9 -> 0.7 so that 30% of motorcycles are moto_seeker and can use wrong lane or sidewalk, targeting M8/moto (0.249) and M10a (0.56 veh/cycle).

Same riding values as moto_saval. Share raised 0.1 -> 0.3 because M8/moto = 0.249 of turning motorcycles use a wrong lane and F2/p/wrong_lane is 0.19-0.23; with p_wrong_lane 0.5 about 15% of motorcycles seek space, the same order of magnitude, without overshooting before any feedback.
Unchanged: the prompt contains no M7a/M7b/M7c or M6/illegal_l simulated value, so jmTimegapMinor stays at the base 1.0 s until feedback shows whether box waiters leave too early or too late.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto = 0.098 (observed). Saval's 0.5 applies to front-row motorcycles only, and across all motorcycles the observed share is about 0.1; p0 = p_max = 0.15 lowers red running toward M3/share/moto and M3/per_cycle = 3.9 (red runners also come from early start and the box). k stays 0 (no swarm evidence beyond M3/var_to_mean 1.14, near Poisson).

Targets M2/early/moto = 0.1302 share in the last 10 s of red (cars 0.011 stay at p = 0 as the rule applies to motorcycles only): p = 0.13 matches the observed share, t_before_green = 7 s lies inside the 4-10 s target lead time, and v_max = 2 m/s is a slow creep that does not distort M2/first_delay (2.83 s).

q = 15 m is the observed queue at choice (M10b/queue_at_choice 15.3 m, M9c 15.7 m, M5/length 15.8 m); F2/p/wrong_lane is 0.19-0.23 at q 0-40 m so p_wrong_lane = 0.5 among seekers (30% share) gives roughly M8/moto 0.25 order. p_sidewalk = 0.1 targets F2/p/sidewalk 0.009-0.049 and M10a 0.56 veh/cycle; p_right_lane stays 0 (option absent on this site); green check off and v_creep, merge_zone_m kept at base.

reasoning: No simulated-metric feedback is in the request, so car-following values, jmTimegapMinor and structure stay at the base and only mechanisms with clear targets are moved. Red running is cut from 0.5 to 0.15 because the observed M3/share/moto is 0.098 (the 0.5 of Saval is for front-row riders only); early_start is switched on at p = 0.13 to match M2/early/moto = 0.1302. Moto seekers go from 0.1 to 0.3 of the moto distribution, with q = 15 m (M10b/M5 queue about 15 m), p_wrong_lane 0.5 (F2/p/wrong_lane 0.19-0.23, M8/moto 0.249) and p_sidewalk 0.1 (F2/p/sidewalk up to 0.049, M10a 0.56 veh/cycle). Shares in each distribution sum to 1 and all values are inside the stated bounds.
